ayahs.ar: قُلۡ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسۡتَمَعَ نَفَرࣱ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا سَمِعۡنَا قُرۡءَانًا عَجَبࣰ ا
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an
ayahs.e2: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “It has been revealed to me that a group of jinn listened ˹to the Quran,˺ and said ˹to their fellow jinn˺: ‘Indeed, we have heard a wondrous recitation
ayahs.tr: Qul oohiya ilaiya annna hustama'a nafarum minal jinnni faqaalooo innaa sami'naa quraanan 'ajabaa

ayahs.ar: يَهۡدِيٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشۡدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ وَلَن نُّشۡرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدࣰ ا
ayahs.en: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone
ayahs.e2: It leads to Right Guidance so we believed in it, and we will never associate anyone with our Lord ˹in worship˺
ayahs.tr: Yahdeee ilar rushdi fa aamannaa bihee wa lan nushrika bi rabbinaaa ahadaa

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةࣰ وَلَا وَلَدࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son
ayahs.e2: ˹Now, we believe that˺ our Lord—Exalted is His Majesty—has neither taken a mate nor offspring
ayahs.tr: Wa annahoo Ta'aalaa jaddu Rabbinaa mat takhaza saahibatanw wa la waladaa

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And that our foolish one has been saying about Allah an excessive transgression
ayahs.e2: and that the foolish of us used to utter ˹outrageous˺ falsehoods about Allah
ayahs.tr: Wa annahoo kaana yaqoolu safeehunaa 'alal laahi shatataa

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلۡإِنسُ وَٱلۡجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allah a lie
ayahs.e2: We certainly thought that humans and jinn would never speak lies about Allah
ayahs.tr: Wa annaa zanannaaa al lan taqoolal insu wal jinnu 'alal laahi kazibaa

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالࣱ مِّنَ ٱلۡإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالࣲ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمۡ رَهَقࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden
ayahs.e2: And some men used to seek refuge with some jinn—so they increased each other in wickedness
ayahs.tr: Wa annahoo kaana rijaa lum minal insi ya'oozoona birijaalim minal jinni fazaa doohum rahaqaa

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّهُمۡ ظَنُّواْ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمۡ أَن لَّن يَبۡعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allah would never send anyone [as a messenger]
ayahs.e2: And those ˹humans˺ thought, just like you ˹jinn˺, that Allah would not resurrect anyone ˹for judgment˺
ayahs.tr: Wa annahum zannoo kamaa zanantum al lany yab'asal laahu ahadaa

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّا لَمَسۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدۡنَٰهَا مُلِئَتۡ حَرَسࣰ ا شَدِيدࣰ ا وَشُهُبࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames
ayahs.e2: ˹Earlier˺ we tried to reach heaven ˹for news˺, only to find it filled with stern guards and shooting stars
ayahs.tr: Wa annaa lamasnas sa maaa'a fa wajadnaahaa muli'at harasan shadeedanw wa shuhubaa

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقۡعُدُ مِنۡهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمۡعِۖ فَمَن يَسۡتَمِعِ ٱلۡأٓنَ يَجِدۡ لَهُۥ شِهَابࣰ ا رَّصَدࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him
ayahs.e2: We used to take up positions there for eavesdropping, but whoever dares eavesdrop now will find a flare lying in wait for them
ayahs.tr: Wa annaa kunnaa naq'udu minhaa maqaa'ida lis'sam'i famany yastami'il aana yajid lahoo shihaabar rasada

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدۡرِيٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ أَرَادَ بِهِمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ رَشَدࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course
ayahs.e2: Now, we have no clue whether evil is intended for those on earth, or their Lord intends for them what is right
ayahs.tr: Wa annaa laa nadreee asharrun ureeda biman fil ardi am araada bihim rabbuhum rashadaa

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways
ayahs.e2: Among us are those who are righteous and those who are less so. We have been of different factions
ayahs.tr: Wa annaa minnas saalihoona wa minnaa doona zaalika kunnaa taraaa'ilqa qidadaa

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعۡجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَن نُّعۡجِزَهُۥ هَرَبࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allah upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight
ayahs.e2: ˹Now,˺ we truly know that we cannot frustrate Allah on earth, nor can we escape from Him ˹into heaven˺
ayahs.tr: Wa annaa zanannaaa al lan nu'jizal laaha fil ardi wa lan nu'jizahoo harabaa

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعۡنَا ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ فَمَن يُؤۡمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخۡسࣰ ا وَلَا رَهَقࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And when we heard the guidance, we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden
ayahs.e2: When we heard the guidance ˹of the Quran˺, we ˹readily˺ believed in it. For whoever believes in their Lord will have no fear of being denied ˹a reward˺ or wronged
ayahs.tr: Wa annaa lammaa sami'nal hudaaa aamannaa bihee famany yu'mim bi rabbihee falaa yakhaafu bakhsanw wa laa rahaqaa

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلۡمُسۡلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلۡقَٰسِطُونَۖ فَمَنۡ أَسۡلَمَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوۡاْ رَشَدࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allah], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course
ayahs.e2: And among us are those who have submitted ˹to Allah˺ and those who are deviant. So ˹as for˺ those who submitted, it is they who have attained Right Guidance
ayahs.tr: Wa annaa minnal muslimoona wa minnal qaasitoona faman aslama fa ulaaa'ika taharraw rashadaa

ayahs.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلۡقَٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُواْ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبࣰ ا
ayahs.en: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood
ayahs.e2: And as for the deviant, they will be fuel for Hell.’”
ayahs.tr: Wa ammal qaasitoona fa kaanoo li jahannama hatabaa

ayahs.ar: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسۡتَقَٰمُواْ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And [Allah revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant provision
ayahs.e2: Had the deniers followed the Right Way, We would have certainly granted them abundant rain to drink—
ayahs.tr: Wa alla wis taqaamoo 'alat tareeqati la asqaynaahum maa'an ghadaqaa

ayahs.ar: لِّنَفۡتِنَهُمۡ فِيهِۚ وَمَن يُعۡرِضۡ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسۡلُكۡهُ عَذَابࣰ ا صَعَدࣰ ا
ayahs.en: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment
ayahs.e2: as a test for them. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of their Lord will be admitted by Him into an overwhelming punishment
ayahs.tr: Linaftinahum feeh; wa many yu'rid 'an zikri rabbihee yasluk hu 'azaaban sa'adaa

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّ ٱلۡمَسَٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدۡعُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allah, so do not invoke with Allah anyone
ayahs.e2: The places of worship are ˹only˺ for Allah, so do not invoke anyone besides Him
ayahs.tr: Wa annal masaajida lillaahi falaa tad'oo ma'al laahi ahadaa

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبۡدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدۡعُوهُ كَادُواْ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيۡهِ لِبَدࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And that when the Servant of Allah stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass
ayahs.e2: Yet when the servant of Allah stood up calling upon Him ˹alone˺, the pagans almost swarmed over him
ayahs.tr: Wa annahoo lammaa qaama 'adul laahi yad'oohu kaadoo yakoonoona 'alaihi libadaa

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَدۡعُواْ رَبِّي وَلَآ أُشۡرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدࣰ ا
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone
ayahs.e2: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I call only upon my Lord, associating none with Him ˹in worship˺.”
ayahs.tr: Qul innamaaa ad'oo rabbee wa laaa ushriku biheee ahadaa

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ إِنِّي لَآ أَمۡلِكُ لَكُمۡ ضَرࣰّ ا وَلَا رَشَدࣰ ا
ayahs.en: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction
ayahs.e2: Say, “It is not in my power to harm or benefit you.”
ayahs.tr: Qul innee laaa amliku lakum darranw wa laa rashadaa

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ إِنِّي لَن يُجِيرَنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدࣱ وَلَنۡ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلۡتَحَدًا
ayahs.en: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allah anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge
ayahs.e2: Say, “No one can protect me from Allah ˹if I were to disobey Him˺, nor can I find any refuge other than Him
ayahs.tr: Qul innee lany yujeeranee minal laahi ahad, wa lan ajida min doonihee multahadaa

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا بَلَٰغࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَٰلَٰتِهِۦۚ وَمَن يَعۡصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا
ayahs.en: But [I have for you] only notification from Allah, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever
ayahs.e2: ˹My duty is˺ only to convey ˹the truth˺ from Allah and ˹deliver˺ His messages.” And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger will certainly be in the Fire of Hell, to stay there for ever and ever
ayahs.tr: Illaa balaagham minal laahi wa risaalaatih; wa many ya'sil laaha wa rasoolahoo fa inna lahoo naara jahannama khaalideena feehaaa abadaa

ayahs.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوۡاْ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ أَضۡعَفُ نَاصِرࣰ ا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدࣰ ا
ayahs.en: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number
ayahs.e2: Only when they see what they have been threatened with will they know who is weaker in helpers and inferior in manpower
ayahs.tr: Hattaaa izaa ra aw maa yoo'adoona fasaya'lamoona man ad'afu naasiranw wa aqallu 'adadaa

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ إِنۡ أَدۡرِيٓ أَقَرِيبࣱ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمۡ يَجۡعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّيٓ أَمَدًا
ayahs.en: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period
ayahs.e2: Say, “I do not know if what you are promised is near or my Lord has set a distant time for it
ayahs.tr: Qul in adreee a qareebum maa too'adoona am yaj'alu lahoo rabbeee amadaa

ayahs.ar: عَٰلِمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ فَلَا يُظۡهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيۡبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
ayahs.en: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone
ayahs.e2: ˹He is the˺ Knower of the unseen, disclosing none of it to anyone
ayahs.tr: Aalimul ghaibi falaa yuzhiru alaa ghaibiheee ahadaa

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرۡتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولࣲ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسۡلُكُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِۦ رَصَدࣰ ا
ayahs.en: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before each messenger and behind him observers
ayahs.e2: except messengers of His choice. Then He appoints angel-guards before and behind them
ayahs.tr: Illaa manir tadaa mir rasoolin fa innahoo yasluku mim baini yadihi wa min khalfihee rasadaa

ayahs.ar: لِّيَعۡلَمَ أَن قَدۡ أَبۡلَغُواْ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ وَأَحۡصَىٰ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ عَدَدَۢا
ayahs.en: That he may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number
ayahs.e2: to ensure that the messengers fully deliver the messages of their Lord—though He ˹already˺ knows all about them, and keeps account of everything.”
ayahs.tr: Liya'lama an qad ablaghoo risaalaati rabbihim wa ahaata bima ladihim wa ahsaa kulla shai'in 'adadaa
